FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP.title: NP
FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_NP.description:
1. When you play a non-Noble card, gain {NpRate}%[gold]NP[/gold]per energy spent.
2. Gain[gold]NP[/gold]equal to attack damage taken.
3. At 100%+, you can use your Noble Phantasm.

FGO_STATIC_HOVER_TIPS_STAR.description: At 10+ stars, your next attack deals double damage and consumes 10 stars.
